body_markdown:
SOUTH BOSTON, Va., Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — **IperionX Limited (NASDAQ: IPX, ASX: IPX) (IperionX)** has signed a Scheme Implementation Deed (SID) with IperionX Inc., a company incorporated in Texas (US Holdco), to give effect to its proposed redomiciliation to the United States.


**Highlights**


- **Scheme Implementation Deed:** IperionX has executed a Scheme Implementation Deed under which IperionX Inc., a Texas corporation (US Holdco), would become the new parent company of the IperionX group, advancing the proposed redomiciliation announced on August 3, 2026.
- **Corporate and operational Alignment:** Redomiciling to the United States aligns IperionX’s corporate domicile with its 100% U.S.-based operating footprint, including all manufacturing facilities, mineral assets, R&D operations, and principal offices.
- **Alignment with U.S. government priorities:** A U.S.-domiciled parent aligns and builds on IperionX’s U.S. government awards to re-shore domestic titanium and critical minerals supply chains.
- **Stronger Commercial and Government positioning:** Redomiciling to the United States reinforces IperionX’s standing as a domestic titanium supplier for defense, aerospace, consumer electronics, automotive and industrial manufacturers.
- **Direct Nasdaq primary listing with continued ASX access:** US Holdco common shares would assume a direct primary listing on Nasdaq (replacing existing American Depositary Shares, or ADSs), while Australian investors retain local market access via CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs) quoted on ASX.
- **Capital Markets & Compliance Benefits:** Replacing the ADS structure is intended to broaden institutional and strategic investor participation, deepen access to U.S. equity and debt capital markets, and mitigate duplicated reporting obligations should IperionX cease to qualify as a U.S. foreign private issuer.
- **Exchange terms:** Holders of IperionX ordinary shares would receive one common share in the new parent (US Holdco) for every 10 IperionX ordinary shares, issued by default as 10 CHESS Depositary Interests quoted on ASX, unless a shareholder validly elects to receive US Holdco common shares directly. Holders of American Depositary Shares would receive one common share for each American Depositary Share.
- **Unanimous Board recommendation:** The IperionX Board unanimously recommends that shareholders vote in favor of the Scheme, subject to the Independent Expert concluding, and continuing to conclude, that the Scheme is in the best interests of shareholders.


Under the proposed Australian scheme of arrangement (Scheme), US Holdco would acquire all IperionX ordinary shares and become the new parent company of IperionX and its subsidiaries (Group). US Holdco common shares would be listed on Nasdaq in place of IperionX’s American Depositary Shares (ADSs), and US Holdco CHESS Depositary Interests (CDIs) would be quoted on ASX in place of IperionX ordinary shares.


Executing the SID advances the alignment of IperionX’s corporate domicile with its American industrial platform, which integrates titanium metal production and advanced manufacturing in Virginia, the Atlas-Titan critical minerals platform in Tennessee, and titanium technology R&D in Utah. By linking domestic critical mineral resources and recycled titanium feedstocks with proprietary processing technologies, IperionX is positioned to supply titanium products for defense, aerospace, and demanding industrial applications.


**IperionX Executive Chairman Todd Hannigan said:**


*“We are building an American titanium business with the resources, technologies and manufacturing capabilities to strengthen domestic supply chains. Establishing a U.S. parent aligns our corporate structure with the American titanium business we are now scaling. We believe a direct Nasdaq listing and U.S. domicile will strengthen our standing with U.S. government partners and commercial customers, broaden our institutional investor base, and position the Company for its next phase of growth.”*


**Why the Board Supports the Proposed Redomiciliation**


The Board of Directors of IperionX believes a U.S.-domiciled parent with a direct Nasdaq primary listing strengthens the Company’s platform to execute its titanium and critical minerals strategy and build long-term shareholder value:


**Building on U.S. government alignment.** IperionX has secured US$59.8 million in awards under the Defense Production Act Title III and Industrial Base Analysis and Sustainment programs to support U.S. titanium manufacturing and critical minerals development. Funding under these awards is provided as reimbursement of eligible expenditure. A U.S. parent further aligns IperionX with federal priorities to onshore critical supply chains and may strengthen its eligibility and positioning for additional program funding for future growth while reducing reliance on equity funding.


**Strengthening relationships with customers.** A U.S.-domiciled parent strengthens IperionX’s position as a domestic American titanium supplier. The Board believes this positioning may enhance engagement with defense, aerospace, automotive, consumer electronics, and industrial manufacturers seeking secure domestic supply, supporting commercial partnerships and long-term supply agreements as product capabilities expand.


**Broadening capital markets access and investor participation.** Transitioning from an ADS structure to direct Nasdaq-listed common shares offers a standard equity structure for U.S.-focused institutional and strategic investors. The Board believes this may expand investor participation and improve access to the depth and diversity of U.S. equity and debt capital markets to support manufacturing expansion and critical minerals development.


**Aligning the corporate structure with the operating business.** IperionX’s manufacturing facilities, research activities and mineral assets are all located in the United States. A U.S. parent aligns legal domicile with operational reality. It may also prevent duplicative compliance burdens: if IperionX remained domiciled in Australia and ceased to qualify as a U.S. foreign private issuer, it would face full U.S. domestic issuer reporting obligations alongside its existing Australian requirements.


**Preserving Australian market access.** Retaining a secondary ASX listing via CDIs ensures eligible Australian shareholders can maintain local trading exposure or elect to hold Nasdaq-listed common shares directly, while anchoring the primary listing in the capital market most closely aligned with the business.


**IperionX CEO Taso Arima said:**


*“Our operational focus is clear: scaling domestic titanium manufacturing and delivering commercial-grade products to customers who depend on resilient U.S. supply chains. A U.S. parent structure and direct Nasdaq listing directly support that industrial strategy – strengthening our ability to secure strategic funding, deepen customer partnerships, and execute our expansion plans.”*


**What the Scheme Means for Shareholders**


If the Scheme is implemented, IperionX Limited would become a wholly owned subsidiary of US Holdco. US Holdco common shares would have their primary listing on Nasdaq, replacing IperionX’s existing ADSs, and US Holdco CDIs would be quoted on ASX as a secondary listing, replacing IperionX ordinary shares. IperionX expects to retain the IPX ticker on both exchanges, subject to exchange approval.


Ten US Holdco CDIs would represent one US Holdco common share. Subject to eligibility and the sale facility arrangements described below, the proposed exchange is summarized in the following table.


**Table 1: Current holding and proposed consideration for IperionX securities.**


**Current holding** **Proposed consideration**


**IperionX ordinary shares** One US Holdco common share for every 10 IperionX ordinary shares held on the Scheme record date, with any fractional entitlement rounded up to the next whole US Holdco common share. By default, holders would receive 10 CDIs for each US Holdco common share so calculated, and may instead validly elect to receive those common shares directly.


**IperionX ADSs** Each ADS currently represents 10 IperionX ordinary shares. Holders would receive one US Holdco common share for each ADS.


Ineligible Foreign Holders and Non-Electing Small Parcel Holders would receive their share of the net proceeds from the sale of their attributable CDIs through the Sale Facility. The Scheme Booklet will explain eligibility, the separate process for small-parcel holders to opt out of the Sale Facility, and the elections and deadlines for choosing common shares.


The transaction is not expected to change the Group’s underlying business, assets, operations, management or strategy. Eligible holders would retain investment exposure to that business through the new parent, subject to rounding and the Sale Facility arrangements. Rounding may result in minor changes to holders’ proportionate interests. The Scheme would also change the legal rights and tax considerations associated with an investment in the Group; these will be explained in the Scheme Booklet.


Existing IperionX options, performance rights and restricted stock units are proposed to be exchanged for corresponding US Holdco awards under separate exchange deeds. The replacement awards would reflect the same 10-for-one exchange ratio, with fractional entitlements rounded down. Full terms will be described in the Scheme Booklet.


**Board Recommendation and Independent Expert**


The IperionX Directors unanimously recommend that shareholders vote in favor of the Scheme, subject to the independent expert appointed by IperionX (Independent Expert) concluding, and continuing to conclude, that the Scheme is in the best interests of shareholders. Each Director who holds or controls IperionX shares intends to vote those shares in favor of the Scheme, subject to the same qualification.


IperionX has appointed RSM Corporate Australia Pty Ltd as the Independent Expert to assess whether the Scheme is in the best interests of shareholders. The Independent Expert’s Report will be included in the Scheme Booklet, which will also set out the reasons for the Directors’ recommendation and details of their interests in the Scheme.


**Conditions and Indicative Timetable**


Shareholders do not need to take any action at this stage. Implementation of the Scheme remains subject to the conditions in the SID, including approval by the requisite majorities of IperionX shareholders, Court approval, the Independent Expert concluding (and continuing to conclude) that the Scheme is in the best interests of shareholders, the necessary regulatory and exchange approvals, and arrangements enabling the issue and quotation of US Holdco CDIs. The exchange approvals include the admission of US Holdco to the official list of ASX, quotation of its CDIs on ASX, and approval of the listing of its common shares on Nasdaq.


A copy of the SID is attached to this announcement. It sets out the full terms and conditions of the proposed transaction, including the circumstances in which the SID may be terminated.


Subject to the Court process and regulatory review, IperionX currently expects to dispatch the Scheme Booklet in December 2026, hold the shareholder meeting to vote on the Scheme (Scheme Meeting) in January 2027 and, if the required approvals are obtained and the other conditions are satisfied or (where permitted) waived, implement the Scheme in February 2027. These dates are indicative and may change. The detailed timetable, voting instructions and election procedures will be provided in the Scheme Booklet.


**Next Steps for Shareholders**


Shareholders do not need to take any action at this time. IperionX encourages all shareholders to carefully review the Scheme Booklet and Independent Expert’s Report in full upon release. The Scheme Booklet will comprehensively address the potential advantages and disadvantages of the Scheme, transaction costs, changes to shareholder rights, tax implications, and associated risks. There is no certainty that the Scheme will proceed, and the anticipated funding, capital-markets, and commercial benefits are not guaranteed.


**About IperionX**


IperionX is developing an integrated American titanium and critical minerals business. Its platform combines titanium metal production and advanced manufacturing in Virginia, titanium technology research and development in Utah, and the Atlas-Titan critical minerals platform in Tennessee. IperionX’s strategy is to connect domestic mineral resources and recycled feedstocks with proprietary processing technologies to supply titanium powders, mill products and engineered components for defense, aerospace, automotive, consumer electronics and industrial markets.
